description: This file defines the DeviceIdentity management logic, including the data structure for device identity, paths for storing identity data, loading or creating identities, signing payloads with private keys, and generating new identities. It also includes utilities for encoding cryptographic data.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A struct representing the device's identity, including device ID, public key, private key, and timestamp of creation.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Determines the directory URL where the device identity state is stored, based on environment variables or default paths.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads an existing device identity from disk, or creates a new one if none exists or data is invalid.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key, returning the signature as a URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with a freshly created key pair and a device ID based on public key hash.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes data into a URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key encoded in URL-safe base64 format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and writes the device identity to disk.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the device identity JSON file based on the state directory path.
